blocks.text: 实讯小车 · VXS-100 · IoT teaching
One education line I owned end-to-end — robot + training car + handheld control — for university IoT labs.
Mecanum training platform — the fleet vehicle that docks with Zongheng Robot for classroom IoT labs.
The Zongheng education robot pairs with the Shixun (实讯) Mecanum training car — docking / charge support for classroom fleets and hands-on IoT labs.
Students drive Inventing System practice and embedded fundamentals on a physical chassis, not only slides.

blocks.text: Handheld control unit — the bridge between instructor demos and student fleets.
VX-X / VXS-100 is the handheld voice module used to operate the Shixun car and Zongheng robots.
It sits between lecture demos and lab sessions — one controller language across the education line.
